title: Customer Success Specialist | Morning Shift | WFH
tools_required: crm; zoho; customer service; customer support; admin
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 5 skills: crm, zoho, customer service, customer support, admin. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview: Platinum Outsourcing is one of Australia's fastest growing companies, we are a co sourcing BPO - operating out of both the Philippines and Indonesia. We are a fast growing scale-up, opening our first offices in the Philippines only 4.5 years ago, currently a global team of 250, we have plans to expand to 500+ employees over the next 3 years. Our client is growing their remote team here in the Philippines. They have built smart and affordable work health and safety management software designed specifically to deliver a sustainable and effective safety program over time. They are seeking a Customer Success Specialist to be the first point of contact for customers, managing high-volume enquiries, check-ins and admin through defined processes. Supports Customer Success and Sales by taking on repeatable coordination work. Core scope Enquiries and triage: Monitor inboxes, acknowledge, route and schedule responses Customer check-ins: Run scripted check-ins and capture outcomes Admin tasks: Process standard requests (e.g. licence changes) via workflows Customer support: Direct customers to approved resources or internal teams, uncover/identify opportunities for licence expansion CRM hygiene: Keep records, notes and handovers accurate and up to date Boundaries Non-advisory, non-sales role No consulting, pricing decisions, negotiation or WHS advice Work within SOPs, scripts and escalation pathways Escalate anything requiring judgement or outside standard process Success measures Fast response and correct triage Timely completion of standard tasks Check-ins completed and documented High-quality CRM records and adherence to process Profile Health and Safety experience (direct/indirect) is highly desirable - means they will more likely get the client Strong customer service and communication skills Highly organised and process-driven Comfortable with CRM - Zoho, help desk, outbound calls and Microsoft 365 tools Originally posted on Himalayas
